title: Baseline release 2026.10: render again (`tend baseline render --write`)
body:
+ rust.ci-reads-toolchain: CI takes the toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml (rustup reads it when cargo runs); a workflow never pins a second version beside it.
~ rust.clippy-clean: Code is clippy-clean with warnings denied (cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings), in CI too, under every feature set CI builds.
+ rust.features-additive: Features only add: one never changes a type, a default or a behaviour another crate may rely on, since features unify across a build.
